name: ode-brand
description: The Ode with Anthropic brand system: the brand foundation (palette, typography, logo usage, voice, design principles, and the licensed font and logo asset files) plus the two artifact engines that build on it, ode-pdf for print-quality HTML-to-PDF documents and ode-slides for editable .pptx decks. Use when an artifact needs to be on-brand, or when asked for brand colors, the Ode palette, an on-brand doc, deck, or app UI. (Ode is the new name for the team formerly branded Fractional AI.)
